experimentalType: fresh-seed prospective A/B/A owner-policy intervention; same registered physical deals and candidate/source 60s in all phases
sourceSeatAllocationRule: Rank 6 uses candidateSlot B (original source physical seat 0); rank 11 uses candidateSlot A (original source physical seat 1), covering both source seats.
seedOrigin: Two independent secrets.randbits(32) calls executed on Python runtime and observed at 2026-11-07T09:09:57 UTC before registration and before any native run: rank6=2037689663, rank11=1518610907.
policyLayers: All phases use the same source-independent bilateral v8 common policy, Telepath owner-only ChooseCards continuation, owner-only Radiant Eternatus/Articuno-GX Confirm policy, Radiant zero-search correction, owner Prize/Promotion continuation, bilateral Volt continuation and Thorns direct-root flag. Only phase B enables the existing canonical actor inner ownerVipAfterPass handler through AGENT9_BATTLE_VIP_AFTER_PASS_DEV=true; A and A2 leave it disabled.
randomnessProtocol: isolatePolicyRandomness=true and isolatePhysicalShuffleRandomnessAfterSetup=true for all phases. Each phase reuses identical registered trial IDs, decklists, physical seat allocation and seed. No seed selection or root filtering after results.
controlProtocol: A/B/A in fixed order. Compare sourceDealFingerprint and fullPhysicalDealFingerprint within each exact trial. A2 must reproduce A's public root ledger and outcome. B's first root-ledger divergence is attributed to the VIP treatment only if it is a genuine Battle VIP Pass FST PlayCardAction replacing the same owner's PassTurnAction; otherwise record the actual divergence without treating it as a VIP effect.
rootCensoring: 240 accepted native root actions per arm. Native terminal, engine error, early return and root cap are retained separately. A capped game is not a win or loss. The 240-root ceiling is a development horizon, not a completed-game guarantee.
independentVerification: Require exact A/A2 ledger parity, physical deal fingerprint parity across phases, native accepted VIP Store action, actual owner deck prompt settlement, physical deck-to-Bench movement, source/candidate action traces, and all failure receipts. Existing Agent16 v11 native VIP tests and v8 Telepath/Confirm tests remain part of the manual workflow.
scopeLimitations: Only original source ranks 6 and 11 of the 29 authenticated source lists are included. Both candidate 60s are developmental contenders, not a final selection. This experiment does not establish full-field performance, a completed paper-valid game, opponent competence, official 25-minute clock compliance, or any win-rate estimate.
